title: qory-stack.yaml
description: qory-stack.yaml: the ordered modules a harness is composed from, delivered to be extended; the checkout extending it defines what it is rendered for.

qory.description: The qory versions this document is written for: one or more comparators, such as >=0.3.0 <0.4.0; every one has to be satisfied.

bind.description: The entry that fills each role a document references, by kind and then by role: agents, commands or skills, each a map of a role to the name of one entry of that kind. A module writes ${qory:agents/coder}, and bind: {agents: {coder: rails-coder}} sets which agent that is.

extensions.description: Values qory copies into the report and does not read: keys of the author's choosing, each a value of any shape.

workflows.description: The settings of each workflow the stack starts, by the workflow's name: a run that Qory Apiary dispatches starts the skill or command workflow-<name>, or else the one named <name>.

time_limit.description: How long a dispatched run of the workflow may run, counted from the run's open, as a duration: 7h or 45m. The run's run_settings.time_limit_minutes, when Qory Apiary sets it, applies instead. A workflow without it runs for at most 3 hours.

access.description: The access level the workflow declares for what a dispatched run of it works on: read or write. Left out, it is read. A dispatched run from a run code sees the checkout read-only when this access is read or access in the run's documents is read, and on Claude Code its settings deny Edit, Write and NotebookEdit; such a run with no wall, with wall.setup: inside, or whose image chosen at the run's open has nested Docker, whichever way it was selected, stops before the agent starts (docs/run.md, §Read workflows). The run sees the checkout writable only when both are write, or when this access is write and the documents have no access, as documents with no target do.

extending.description: What a module of a checkout extending this stack may ship.

target.description: The targets the stack is written for: the runtimes and the models a checkout extending it may compose for. A resolved target outside either list fails the compose, and a stack that lists models makes the model required. Left out, every target is accepted.

bindRoles.description: The roles of one kind, each to the name of the one entry of that kind that fills the role.

oneOrMore.description: One name, or a list of them.

part.description: A merged part: true for all of it, or the names of some of it.

exclude.description: What of the module the compose leaves out; everything else is composed. Not with only.

only.description: The only things of the module the compose takes; everything not listed is left out. Not with exclude.

link.description: A name at the checkout root that links to the module's directory.

source.description: A directory; a git repository at a ref with the module's directory inside it; or a module the repository exports, selected by module, with path or git and ref defining the repository.

exportName.description: The name of an export, one path segment.
